faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Tiruvallur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the DCPU Tiruvallur Recruitment 2026 is 21st September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Case Worker post?
faq.answer: For the Case Worker post, candidates must be graduates preferably in B.A in Social Work, Computer Sciences, Information Technology, Community Sociology, or Social Sciences from a recognized university. Proficiency in computers is also required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the DCPU Tiruvallur posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts released under the DCPU Tiruvallur Recruitment 2026 is 42 years. There is no mention of age relaxation for any category in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Case Worker post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Case Worker post at the District Child Protection Unit Tiruvallur. In addition, there is 1 vacancy for the Outreach Worker post, making the total number of vacancies 3.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the DCPU Tiruvallur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the DCPU Tiruvallur Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any application charges.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these government jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process for the DCPU Tiruvallur Recruitment 2026 primarily involves Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on the verification of their submitted documents.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Case Worker and Outreach Worker posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Case Worker post is 18000 per month, and for the Outreach Worker post, it is 21000 per month. These are contractual positions.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any preference given to candidates with prior experience?
faq.answer: Yes, preference may be given to personnel having experience of working in Emergency Helplines for both the Case Worker and Outreach Worker positions.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the DCPU Tiruvallur Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and submit it via post or as instructed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Child Protection Unit Tiruvallur, which is https://tiruvallur.nic.in/. It is crucial to refer to the official website for the most accurate and up-to-date information.
